instruction: Set the maximum volume in VLC media player to 200%.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened GNOME Settings, navigated to Default Applications, and changed the default video player from Videos to VLC media player in 9 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open system Settings via Activities search, navigate sidebar menus, use dropdown selectors to change settings
metadata.task_rationale: Since the agent demonstrated proficiency with settings navigation, this variation tests VLC-specific preference changes requiring navigation within VLC's own preferences dialog
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening VLC, navigating to Tools > Preferences, and changing the maximum volume setting to 200%. Evaluator closes VLC to save config, then reads vlcrc to check qt-max-volume value equals 200.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config) correctly reads the VLC configuration file (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc) from the VM
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses vlcrc for 'qt-max-volume=' key and compares against expected value 200
Parameter handling is correct: get_rule returns rules dict directly, metric accesses rule['expected_qt_max_volume'] without incorrect nesting
Postconfig kills VLC before reading config, ensuring settings are saved to disk
Expected value 200 correctly matches the instruction requirement of 200% maximum volume
Single instruction requirement is fully covered by the evaluator
